name: Ripple Cursor
description: A surface that answers the pointer with thin light and dark rings that spread and fade along its path, and a stronger double ring where you click.

props.name: color
props.description: Tint of the rings. The light band is a pale wash of it and the dark band a deep shade of it. Any CSS colour or token.

props.name: strength
props.description: How strongly the rings show. 0 turns the effect off.

props.name: children
props.description: Content above the surface. The rings are drawn beneath it, and the pointer is tracked through it.

props.name: className
props.description: Classes for the root, which is relative and sets the size and background of the surface. Other div props are passed through.
